_evidence: Dword 0x601e88 is read only by 0x00440ce9 (mov eax,[0x601e88]; call 0x410841) - never written, a tuning constant (image 0x8000). 0x410841 accepts any eax (its accepted spec: eax:u32), so the constant draws its image value in about a third of the picks and otherwise other scales (0, 0x4000, 0x10000, 0x12345, 0x7fffffff, 0xffffffff).
